name: model-preflight
description: Checks model and effort fit before work, states a verdict, and pauses for a switch when needed. Maps tasks separately for Claude, Codex and ChatGPT Work, and ChatGPT Chat. Uses a PowerShell 7 or POSIX sh hook on supported hosts and a skill where hooks do not run.

interface.shortDescription: Pause and switch models when the tier does not match the task
